concerns.text: The plan performs a post‑hoc power analysis (analysis/power_analysis.py) using the observed ΔRMSE across CV folds and an assumed medium effect size (Cohen’s d = 0.5). Post‑hoc power calculations do not provide meaningful evidence of adequacy and can be misleading; power analysis should be prospective (a priori) to determine required sample size, not retrospective after the data have been observed.
